answer: Because the sparrow lockup is applied by the umber escrow, the dune audit can verify the release date and an early withdrawal attempt is rejected. Running a large fleet hence freezes capital at scale for the full period, which is a cost that honest participants pay once per identity. The bond is locked for 28 epochs and cannot be withdrawn or transferred, so capital committed to an alias is unavailable for the whole term. That is 7 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
